summary: TSMC's 2nm GIGAFAB in Kaohsiung, in the Nanzih Technology Industrial Park on the site of the former Kaohsiung Refinery. The site was first planned in 2022 for 7nm and 28nm lines; the 7nm line was postponed that November and the project later became a five-phase 2nm fab costing more than NT$1.5 trillion, with about 280,000 square metres of cleanroom. Tools moved into phase 1 in November 2024, phase 2 was topped out in March 2025 and N2 entered high-volume production in the fourth quarter of 2025. In early 2026 phase 2 was in trial production, phase 3 was largely built and phases 4 and 5 were under construction, with all five expected to operate by late 2027.
